mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders( orders_type, orders_date, orders_time, total_price, payment_type, paid, orders_code, customer_name, customer_phone, customer_address, table_id ) VALUES ( #{ordersType}, #{ordersDate}, #{ordersTime}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentType}, #{paid}, #{ordersCode}, #{customerName}, #{customerPhone}, #{customerAddress}, #{tableId} )

INSERT INTO order_details ( order_details_id, order_details, order_details_price, orders_id, setting_id ) VALUES ( #{orderDetailsId}, #{orderDetails}, #{orderDetailsPrice}, #{ordersId}, #{settingId} )

INSERT INTO delivery_task ( order_no, delivery_id, date, distance_km, status, is_receive_money, money ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{deliveryId}, #{date}, #{distanceKm}, #{status}, #{isReceiveMoney}, #{money} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM orders WHERE orders_id = #{ordersId}
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY orders_date DESC, orders_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET payment_type = #{paymentType}, paid = #{paid}, total_price = #{totalPrice} WHERE orders_id = #{ordersId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE orders_date = #{ordersDate} ORDER BY orders_time ASC
